url.label: Home Assistant URL
url.help: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance (fallback: HASS_URL env var, default http://homeassistant.local:8123). Operator-owned: the agent cannot choose the host.

token.label: Home Assistant Token
token.help: Long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile (fallback: HASS_TOKEN env var).

timeoutSeconds.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for each Home Assistant REST call. Default: 15.

maxEntities.label: Max Entities per Listing
maxEntities.help: Upper bound on entities returned by list_entities, so a large install stays answerable. Default: 200.
